title: Midsummer Run
description: Cross the brightest June morning, a flower valley and sunlit climb to a huge midsummer plateau and golden-evening horizon. Expert redesign: midsummer light gates and rotating sun sails.

rooms.name: The midsummer morning
rooms.lesson: Begin beneath the longest day’s sky. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: The flower valley
rooms.lesson: Follow the wide valley’s bellflower arcs. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: The sunlit hill
rooms.lesson: Climb from flowers into the long light. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: The midsummer plateau
rooms.lesson: A broad high crossing under an enormous sky. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.

rooms.name: The golden-evening horizon
rooms.lesson: Keep moving into the warm evening light. The amber guide is safe; the bright beam is lethal.
